name: Barra fixa
directions: Pullup on overhead fixed horizontal bar. Both hands pronated slightly wider than shoulders stay FIXED to bar. Start hanging with long arms FEET CLEAR of floor; pull whole body UP until CHIN above bar. Same proportions throughout, knees slightly bent behind, no swing.
instructions: Pegada pronada, um pouco mais aberta que os ombros.
Puxe até o queixo passar a barra.
